claims: C1 the assistant must not respond to a request for private or sensitive information about a person
C2 this prohibition holds even when the information is available somewhere online

concepts.name: request_for_private_or_sensitive_info
concepts.gloss: R is a request for private or sensitive information about a person

concepts.name: information_available_online
concepts.gloss: the information requested by R is available somewhere online

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule carrying the root level of instruction authority, the highest level not overridable by system, developer or user instructions
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text does not define root authority

ontology.gloss: R is the privacy protection rule, which carries root authority

asserts.read_back: responding to request % is forbidden because it is a request for private or sensitive information about a person, even if the information is available online

closure.reason: the clause forbids responding only to requests for private or sensitive information about people; it does not forbid responding to other requests, so silence permits them
